dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I used to believe that once I'd made up my mind to do something, I should act immediately and complete the work in the shortest timeframe possible.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: But I found that my assistants rarely lasted more than 3 months on the job, and the constant turnover took a toll on our operational efficiency.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Eventually, of course, I came to realize that getting adequate rest actually improves productivity in the long term.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Our foes grow in strength, but that isn't entirely a bad thing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: You need constant challenges to keep your skills strong and your judgment sharp — otherwise, you lose your edge. There's no useful experienced to be gleaned from plateauing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: We've got each other's backs. So let's push ourselves today.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: If we wish to forge a new future, we cannot expect to stick to the same path trod by our forebears.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: And yet, many of the principles put forth in ancient writings are versatile in their application. So it is wise to be versed in the past as we consider the future.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: These days, I tend to take a look at any relevant historical records whenever I have an important decision to make. I always find it helps me come up with some good ideas.
